meta.notes: The jukebox song: which sound plays (msm_starter:music_disc.my_song, defined in this pack's sounds element; the object form { sound_id } names a sounds.json key directly, while a bare string would have to be a registered sound event), the "Now playing" text, how long the jukebox counts as playing and the redstone signal a comparator reads (0 to 15). Set length_in_seconds to the length of your own track.
